# MAPF 两条研究支线

GitHub入口与 [项目README](https://github.com/LYHrmer/MAPF_PIED_MDDR_RESEARCH/blob/main/README.md) 一致。2026-10-18起采用SCI小论文与硕士论文两条线，共享必要底座；旧“四分支只服务一个误差问题”不再适用。

- [唯一当前研究决定](https://github.com/LYHrmer/MAPF_PIED_MDDR_RESEARCH/blob/main/docs/RESEARCH_PLAN.md)
- [SCI支线](https://github.com/LYHrmer/MAPF_PIED_MDDR_RESEARCH/blob/research/sci-mapf/tracks/sci/README.md)
- [硕士论文支线](https://github.com/LYHrmer/MAPF_PIED_MDDR_RESEARCH/blob/research/thesis-integration/tracks/thesis/README.md)
- [最新进度](https://github.com/LYHrmer/MAPF_PIED_MDDR_RESEARCH/blob/main/GITHUB_PROGRESS.md) · [导航](https://github.com/LYHrmer/MAPF_PIED_MDDR_RESEARCH/blob/main/REPOSITORY_NAVIGATION.md)

四次闭式功能DEV已实际完成，全部SUCCESS、枚举收益为零，[原始依据](https://github.com/LYHrmer/MAPF_PIED_MDDR_RESEARCH/blob/ae058c5025eaaa61a424ef7627515d40c2e83997/exploration/spatial_constraints_s1_20261016/PREEXECUTION_DEV_RESULT.md)。当前只推进两线实现和静态核验，不重用已消费许可，不恢复旧查询学习。
